keyVerseDR: "The Lord thy God shalt thou adore, and him only shalt thou serve." (Mt 4:10)

level1.title: Jesus Says No
level1.story: Jesus went into the desert to pray for 40 days. The devil tried to trick Him. Jesus said no and obeyed God.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who did Jesus say no to?
When can you say no to wrong?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me choose what is good. Amen.

activity.title: My Lent plan
activity.intro: Jesus prayed and fasted. Make your plan for Lent.
starters: I will give to others by...

level2.title: Tempted in the Desert
level2.story: After His baptism, the Spirit led Jesus into the desert, where He fasted forty days and forty nights. The devil came and said, "If You are the Son of God, turn these stones into bread." Jesus answered, "One does not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from God." The devil tempted Him two more times, but Jesus said, "Worship the Lord your God, and serve Him only." Then angels came and served Him.
level2.keyLine: The Lord thy God shalt thou adore.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What will you do for prayer, fasting, and almsgiving?
level2.prayer: Jesus, make me strong against temptation. Amen.

activity.title: My media fast
activity.intro: Jesus said no to temptation. Give up some screen time and pray instead.
